4150.title: Legacy sidebar preference normalization changes provider selection
4150.rootCauseOneLine: The default and legacy Automatic values normalize to the bundled provider, overriding implicit community selection.
4150.proposedFix: Decide an upgrade-continuity policy, then migrate prior selections or explain the change and update documentation.
4150.caveats: Unit-level reproduction only; package upgrade, third-party plugin loading, browser rendering and notice behavior were not tested.
